heading: Publication of information on retail purchase prices for representative meat products

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Beginning not later than 90 days after October 22, 1999, the Secretary shall compile and publish at least monthly (weekly, if practicable) information on retail prices for representative food products made from beef, pork, chicken, turkey, veal, or lamb.

tree.heading: Information
tree.text: The report published by the Secretary under subsection (a) shall include—

children.text: information on retail prices for each representative food product described in subsection (a); and
information on total sales quantity (in pounds and dollars) for each representative food product.

tree.heading: Meat Price Spreads Report
tree.text: During the period ending 2 years after the initial publication of the report required under subsection (a), the Secretary shall continue to publish the Meat Price Spreads Report in the same manner as the Report was published before October 22, 1999.

children.heading: In general
children.text: To ensure the accuracy of the reports required under subsection (a), the Secretary shall obtain the information for the reports from one or more sources including—
a consistently representative set of retail transactions; and
both prices and sales quantities for the transactions.
obtain the information from retailers or commercial information sources; and
use valid statistical sampling procedures, if necessary.

children.heading: Adjustments
children.text: In providing information on retail prices under this section, the Secretary may make adjustments to take into account differences in—
the location of the principal source of supply;
such other factors as the Secretary determines reflect a verifiable comparative retail price for a representative food product.
shall collect information under this section only on a voluntary basis; and
shall not impose a penalty on a person for failure to provide the information or otherwise compel a person to provide the information.
